## Context / Problem
On the production MCP host a compaction sweep (`op=compact-sweep`) holds the store write lock 160-280 s per fold. A canonical write waits at most about 181 s (30 s x 2 attempts x 3 passes), so writers fail with `could not acquire lock after 181s ... op=compact-sweep` (2026-11-01 21:03-21:35 PST, evidence on `radiant-benighted-warbler` and `overweak-deviant-shelduck`).

## Root cause
Gerrit 3269 (f1fe7c6f587) added a per-fold timing line. Production sweeps on 2026-11-04 (13:04-13:11 and 17:09-17:17 PST) showed the `ledger` phase was 157-277 s of each 158-278 s hold.
- `_build_authorship_ledger` builds the ticket's position-to-commit map itself (`build_ticket_position_commit_map`, one `git log --full-history` walk) when it receives no map. It runs inside `_fold_under_lock`.
- The sweep shares one store-wide map (`build_position_commit_map`, 300 s subprocess timeout). In production that walk takes 427.5 s, so it returns `{}`, `_sweep_position_map` returns `None`, `_sweep_one_ticket` skips pre-resolution, and every fold walks under the lock. The single-ticket `rebar store compact <id>` path always passes no map.
- Measured in the MCP container on a `git clone --shared` of the live tracker: the per-ticket walk took 160.8 s for 26a0-0104-9b63-4500 (its ledger phase: 165.50 s) and 266.1 s for fb16-a8b0-c2b7-449a (277.48 s).
- The clone replay did not reproduce this because its store-wide walk finished in 111 s, inside the timeout. Production git is 4-8x slower (74,605 loose objects, 235 packs, commit-graph from 2026-08-31), filed as `nickelic-lazuline-gonolek`.

Change 3269 also moved two clone-measured in-lock costs before the lock: identity attribution (`resolve_current_identity` reduced every ticket, 11-58 s on the first fold) and signer lookups (`identify_signer` fetched and waited on the held lock, bug `congruent-demurrable-insect`).

## Approach
Follow the compute-before-lock pattern `_compact_locked` already uses for attribution and signers.
1. New `compact_txn.preresolve_positions(ticket_dir, tracker, repo_root, position_commits)`: when no map was passed, build the per-ticket map; then fill misses through `preresolve_unmapped_positions`. `_compact_locked` calls it before `lock.acquire`, timed as a new `positions` phase, and passes the result to the ledger, so the ledger walks no history except for an event written after the prelude (the existing fallback).
2. `compact._sweep_one_ticket` stops pre-resolving; the fold does it for both paths.
Why this fits: it moves the one measured in-lock cost out of the lock with the existing pattern and adds no lock, config key, env var or flag. It does not make the walk faster; that is `nickelic-lazuline-gonolek`.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py`: `preresolve_positions`, the `positions` phase, prelude call.
- `src/rebar/_commands/compact.py`: drop the sweep's own pre-resolution.
- `tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_perf.py`, `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py`: new tests, phase list.
- Earlier, in 3269: `compact_plan.py` (attribution parameter), `compact_trigger.py` (worker stderr handler).

## Testing
State, not duration: each probe records whether the store lock dir exists when a history walk (`build_position_commit_map`, `build_ticket_position_commit_map`, `resolve_event_commit`, `resolve_position_commit`) is called.
- Production shape: the store-wide walk raises `TimeoutExpired`; the sweep folds the ticket, the per-ticket walk runs, none under the lock, and the ledger attributes a late event to its adding commit.
- Single-ticket `compact_cli`: one per-ticket walk, none under the lock, same ledger attribution.
- Regression: every existing test in both files (map reuse, per-ticket fallback count, merge-only and timed-out positions, ledger parity) and all `-k compact` unit tests pass; `make verify` exits 0.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Identity attribution and signer lookups run before the store write lock: `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py` observes the lock dir at every `_match_by_email` and `identify_signer` call and finds none under the lock.
- [x] While the fold holds the lock it runs no `git fetch`, no `sync.reconverge` and no second `lock.acquire`: checked by the remote-backed test in `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py`.
- [x] The SNAPSHOT's `author_id`/`author_email` and the authorship ledger are unchanged by pre-resolution: checked by the equality tests in `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py`.
- [x] Each fold logs exactly one WARNING timing line naming every phase in `FOLD_PHASES`, including a fold that skips inside the lock, and the detached sweep worker writes it to its stderr log: checked by the timing tests in `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py`.
- [x] [non-codebase] The production hold is diagnosed from the timing lines: the 2026-11-04 production folds' timing lines and the per-ticket walk times measured in the MCP container are recorded in a ticket comment.
  provenance: environment=production MCP host i-00880b2c7f13527c5, rebar-mcp container; principal=operator via AWS SSM; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=live-call — read via SSM AWS-RunShellScript; the evidence is production log output and timings, not repository files.
- [x] No history walk runs under the store write lock when the sweep's store-wide map fails or when a single ticket is folded: `test_a_timed_out_sweep_map_runs_no_history_walk_under_the_lock` and `test_the_single_ticket_fold_runs_no_history_walk_under_the_lock` in `tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_perf.py` pass, and failed before the fix.
- [x] [non-codebase] Production confirms the fix: in the first production sweep after the change deploys, every fold's `compaction fold timing` line shows `held` well under 181 s, and the values are recorded in a ticket comment.
  provenance: environment=production MCP container rebar-mcp-0f409b946e4e-8093 on host i-00880b2c7f13527c5, build 0f409b946e4; principal=operator session via SSM AWS-RunShellScript under the instance role; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — 2026-11-09: the first post-deploy --all sweep (10:48 PST) folded nothing (0 of 10,088 over threshold); the operator-approved sweep-path run at 11:50-11:58 PST (REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=9, --limit=1) folded 029a-c2e8-b4af-44db with held=1.05s (ledger=0.00s, positions=149.28s before the lock), recorded in a ticket comment.
  provenance: environment=production MCP host i-00880b2c7f13527c5, rebar-mcp container; principal=operator via AWS SSM; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=SSM AWS-RunShellScript journalctl -t rebar-mcp — the evidence is production log output, not repository files.
